verdict.rationale: Restate is a durable-execution runtime/infrastructure platform; the evidence pack's 'AI assistant' references (restate-docs-25, -35, -86) describe a plugin that teaches EXTERNAL coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) how to build Restate apps — the reverse of a built-in assistant inside Restate that a user delegates tasks to. No evidence shows any embedded assistant/chatbot within the product itself for task delegation.
